title: Motorcycle Spare Parts Manufacturer in Kenya | Autologic
description: Autologic Industries is a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Kenya, exporting clutch and engine spares for boda boda and commuter motorcycles.
banner_desc: Clutch and engine spares for the boda boda bikes that move people and goods across Kenya.
hero_sub: Spares That Keep Boda Bodas Earning
hero: Boda boda motorcycles carry passengers, parcels and farm produce on every kind of road in Kenya, from city tarmac to rutted murram. As a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Kenya, we provide clutch and engine spares for several popular models, made at our IATF 16949 certified plant in India.
Producing the parts ourselves, with CNC machining, die casting and heat treatment, keeps specifications consistent between orders.
Mixed orders are boxed and labelled by model, shipped to Mombasa and ready for distribution inland.
For a new distributor, the best start is usually the wear parts fundis ask for every week, such as clutch plates and pressure plates, with slower lines added once real sales are known.
Our team can help you choose a balanced first order for the motorcycles your customers ride.
